violations.why: Only irq_meadow is enabled after line 17. It can fire between the check at 18 and the reset at 19, so the reset acts on a stale value.
irq_meadow enables interrupt 2 at line 33. irq_vessel can then fire between 18 and 19 and modify the value, which line 19 then overwrites.
Interrupts are enabled between line 26 and the disable at line 16 (during init()). irq_nectar can change the value, so the read at 18 does not see what line 26 wrote.
irq_vessel can run after the write at 26 and before the read at 18, while interrupts are still enabled.
irq_meadow can run after the write at 26 and before the read at 18, while interrupts are still enabled.
Once interrupt 2 is enabled at line 33, a later irq_meadow run can be preempted by the higher-priority irq_vessel between the read and write of v_lantern++. The vessel's update is then lost.
